response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_margin FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.rate > o.average_rate;
